cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.
